name: Elixir of Fleshsculpting
body:
Price varies (least 400 gp, lesser 10,000 gp, greater 75,000 gp, major 200,000 gp); Slot none; CL varies (least CL 1st, lesser CL 5th, greater CL 13th, major CL 20th); Weight —; Aura moderate transmutation

DESCRIPTION

Consuming this murky elixir imbues the drinker’s body with the powers of mutagenic change. The drinker falls unconscious for an hour as their body is warped by the magic, altering their form to their desires. After this hour, they awaken, gaining the benefits of a permanent fleshsculpting, as the promethean’s fleshsculpting class feature. If they already have a permanent fleshsculpting, this replaces it. The strength of the fleshsculpting granted depends on the potency of this elixir:

Least: The drinker alters their appearance. This allows them to change the color of their eyes, skin, or hair, or to adjust their height by plus or minus 6 inches. They can also edit the features of their body, such as changing their facial features, their sex, their voice, rounding or pointing their ears, etc. This ability does not change their weight, so making themselves shorter makes them bulkier, and making themselves taller makes them thinner. This ability can allow the creature to appear as a Different race, sex, or age category for the purposes of Disguise checks, negating those penalties. This fleshsculpting is purely cosmetic, none of the changes provide any mechanical benefits. It can also be combined with an additional non-cosmetic fleshsculpting.
Lesser: The drinker gains the benefit of a single fleshsculpting ability that could be granted by a 1st-level fleshsculpter.
Greater: The drinker gains the benefit of a single fleshsculpting ability that could be granted by a 5th-level fleshsculpter.
Major: The drinker gains the benefit of a single fleshsculpting ability that could be granted by a 13th-level fleshsculpter.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells alter self; Special creator must have the fleshsculpter promethean obsession; Cost varies (least 200 gp, lesser 5,000 gp, greater 37,500 gp, major 100,000 gp)
